title: Singles' Day Beauty Promotions Shift Beyond Discounts as Brands Compete on Consumer Value
summary: As China\'s Singles\' Day shopping festival approaches, beauty brands are moving beyond traditional price-cutting strategies and increasingly focusing on promotional programs designed to enhance perceived consumer value.Across Tmall, brands are combining member-exclusive coupons, prepayment incentives

extraction.key_fact: 광군제를 앞두고 뷰티 브랜드들이 가격 인하보다 소비자가 느끼는 가치를 높이는 프로모션에 힘을 싣고 있다.
